final_message:
Blog slugs now keep the base letter of accented characters, so "Crème brûlée recipes" becomes `creme-brulee-recipes`. `npm test` passes: 3 of 3, including `test/blog-slug.test.js`.

The cause was the vendored `slugify`, which strips every character outside `a-z0-9`, so accented letters were dropped entirely. I didn't touch `vendor/`. Instead, `postSlug` in `src/blog/slug.js` now decomposes accents (`normalize('NFD')`) and removes the combining marks before calling `slugify`.

Shop product URLs call the vendored `slugify` directly, so they still drop accented letters. Fixing that would mean the same change in `src/shop/product-url.js`, or an upgrade of the vendored package by the platform team.
